grandparents_cupboard.reason: Fruit, flour, oats, sugar, almonds, oil, cinnamon and lemon are all ordinary home staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, a mixing bowl and an oven, and rubbing in a crumble is beginner technique.

works.reason: 400g grapes and 4 plums under a 225g oat and almond crumble bound with 5 tbsp oil, baked at 190°C for 30 to 35 minutes, gives a sound crumble for four.

honest_times.reason: Quartering four plums, chopping almonds and rubbing the topping fits in 15 minutes, and the 35-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the lemon is zested as listed, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Grapes make up most of the filling alongside August plums, so they are the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is mostly fruit with oats and almonds and only 50g of sugar across four portions, a fair, real-food afternoon snack.
